f.closedNoMatch: Matching is only done for open and planned calls.

team.title: Find a team
team.lede: Describe a project in a few sentences – for example the abstract of a proposal. We split it into aspects, compare each aspect with the recent publications of every UiS researcher, and suggest people who together cover as many aspects as possible. Add the ones you want to your selection above.
team.label: Project description (a few sentences: aim, methods, data, users)
team.placeholder: e.g. We will develop and clinically validate digital biomarkers of disease progression in Parkinson's disease, combining clinical data with wearable sensors, smart-home sensors and short daily questionnaires, and use machine learning to predict functional decline between clinic visits.
team.privacy: The description is analysed in your browser and is not sent anywhere (writing-assistant extensions are switched off for this box). The first time, a language model of about 120 MB and publication data of about 7 MB are downloaded and then kept in the browser cache.

prompt.title: Prepare AI prompt
prompt.lede: Turn your selection into a ready-made prompt for ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool: the calls' requirements, the researchers' documented expertise and your preferences, with sources and dates. The tool is asked to assess the match, propose a concept per call, assign evidence-based roles and name missing expertise, keeping facts apart from assumptions. The site sends nothing anywhere: you copy or download the text.

ideas.title: Project ideas
ideas.lede: A proposal concept for each selected call, generated by Claude from the full call text and the selected researchers' profiles and publications. When the researchers do not adequately cover a call, you get the reasons and the missing expertise instead of a forced concept. Every idea is an AI-generated draft for the researchers to review.

ideas.step2: The person responsible for the atlas runs the generator on that file (it needs the Claude API key and costs a few cents per call):
ideas.step3: Import the ideas file it writes here. Ideas are kept in this browser, also when you change your selection; export them as Word or Markdown to keep or share them.

priv.title: Privacy and cookies
priv.lede: The Atlas sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking. This page explains what is kept in your browser, what the server records and where the researcher profiles come from.
priv.draft: Draft: this statement is awaiting review by the UiS data protection officer.
priv.storageText: The Atlas uses no cookies. It keeps a few settings and your own work in your browser's storage (localStorage and sessionStorage). This is never sent to UiS or to anyone else and is only used for the functions you use. Such storage needs no consent under the Norwegian Electronic Communications Act (ekomloven § 3-15), because it is strictly necessary for a service you have asked for.
priv.s.work.what: Shortlist, Project builder and project ideas
priv.s.work.why: Your own selections, so they are still there next time.
priv.s.work.how: Until you remove them or clear the storage
priv.s.news.what: Date of the last update you have seen
priv.s.news.why: Counts what is new since your last visit (What's new).
priv.s.funding.why: Keeps the password-protected funding pages open (the password itself is not stored).
priv.s.funding.how: Until the browser tab is closed
priv.s.model.why: Runs the idea and team search in your browser, so your text never leaves it.
priv.s.model.how: In the browser cache, until it is cleared
priv.storageClear: You can remove all of it at any time by clearing the site data for atlas.ux.uis.no in your browser's settings.
priv.serverText: The Atlas is run by the University of Stavanger on a UiS server. Like any web server, it writes a technical log of each request (IP address, time, the address requested and the browser type). The log is used only to run and secure the service, is not used to identify visitors and is deleted after a limited time.
priv.thirdText: All files, including the language model, come from the UiS server: your browser does not contact other services while you use the Atlas. What you type in the search, idea and team boxes is processed in your browser and is not sent anywhere. Links to other sites (Scopus, NVA, ORCID, funders, the feedback questionnaire in Microsoft Forms) take you to those services, where their own privacy terms apply.
priv.profilesText: The profiles show researchers at the University of Stavanger: name, position, unit and work e-mail from the public UiS employee directory, and publication data from Scopus (Elsevier) and NVA (Sikt). The short overviews are written automatically by an AI language model from each researcher's publications and describe research only. The University of Stavanger is the controller. The processing is being reviewed by the UiS Library and the data protection officer.
priv.rightsText: Researchers can ask for corrections or to be left out of the Atlas, and anyone can ask what data about them is used. Contact us through the Feedback page or the UiS data protection officer. You can also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
